newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania tightens borders due to immigrants.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania tightens borders due to immigrants.

text.p: Lithuanian border police said on Tuesday they were tightening borders around the Baltic state after detaining a second large group of illegal immigrants in two days.
"We have detained a group of 11 Afghan immigrants, six women and five men, a kilometre from the Belorussian border in Salcininkai region," Jonas Lazarenka of the Border police told Reuters.
On Sunday border police detained a group of 42 illegal immigrants of various nationality neaer the border with Poland.
With the detentions this week, the number of illegal immigrants seeking entry to Lithuania this year has passed the previous record 1,696 in 1995.
"We have taken additional measures to impose stricter control in the border area as we noticed an increased flow of illegal migration during the holiday period," a police spokesman said.
The detainees are being held in the Pabrate illegal immigrant camp which already houses 379 people, mostly from Afganistan, Pakistan, India and Iraq.
There is no treaty signed on the readmission of illegal immigrants between Lithuania and Belorussia.
